design: Use all 48 frozen starts, both action seeds, the same source construction, native/sham controls, latent-noise pairing, coverage gates and endpoints as the shared-video experiment. Change only the policy that supplies reference commands for the rendered videos. Fit this source's motion and tint templates on the original disjoint development starts.
motivation: Prior to looking at held-out outcomes, the Long-WAM native-source sham qualified on all three single-seed development diagnostics. The shared-source sham qualified on four of twelve full two-seed development starts.
source_comparison: Report how many paired starts pass native-vs-sham on each source, both, either or neither. On shared eligible starts estimate own-minus-shared motion, background RMS, and sham drift with task-stratified paired bootstrap intervals. Report per task and with equal task weights when every task contributes. This additional study has separate results and gates.
